cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: It Was Foreshadowed
cards.instruction: Turn the failure into a planned turning point by returning to earlier details that now appear to predict it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Bring the bowls. That wobble was the start of the trifle, right on cue.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You said it was a wedding cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It was, until the layers settled. I'll make the custard; you can explain the change to the guests.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm not telling them you meant it to collapse.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just bring the bowls, then. I'll tell them why I let it wobble.

reason: Make A absorb the disputed public explanation after B refusal, preserving B cooperation on bowls while continuing to claim the warning was intentional.
